methods.summary: Reads blocks, epoch 2.x headers and MARF proofs from a Stacks node.
methods.description:
Reads blocks, epoch 2.x headers and MARF proofs from a Stacks node.

It uses the node's RPC. Witnesses, burn preimages and Bitcoin headers need
another source: spread this over one.

fields.name: nodeUrl
fields.description: Stacks node RPC origin, e.g. `http://localhost:20443`.

methods.summary: A MARF inclusion proof for a path at a tip.
methods.description:
A MARF inclusion proof for a path at a tip.

It is null when the key is absent.

methods.summary: Reads every proof input from the Secondlayer API.
methods.description:
Reads every proof input from the Secondlayer API.

Blocks, epoch 2.x headers, MARF proofs, witnesses, burn preimages, Bitcoin
headers and each block's state writes come from `/v1/proofs/*`, which is free
and rate limited. Indexed `vm_events` rows come from the Index API as metered
rows, and are read only when `verifyBlock` gets `rows: true`. Methods are own
properties, so a partial source spreads over it:
`{ ...new SecondlayerProofSource(o), ...new NodeRpcProofSource(n) }`.

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.description: API origin. Defaults to [`DEFAULT_API_URL`](/docs/verify-reference#c-DEFAULT_API_URL).

fields.name: apiKey
fields.description:
Optional. Proofs are keyless; a key raises the rate limit. Required for
`rows: true` (metered Index reads). Sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

types.name: BurnPreimage
types.summary: Sortition preimage behind a consensus hash.

fields.name: burnHeight
fields.description: The source's claimed burn height: a hint for how far to sync Bitcoin headers, never trusted.

types.name: Bytes
types.summary: A byte string, held as a Uint8Array.

types.name: Epoch2HeaderResponse
types.summary: An epoch 2.x header and the consensus hash it commits to.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Consensus-serialized StacksBlockHeader.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Value string as Clarity stored it (hex for Clarity values), 0x prefix tolerated.

fields.name: proof
fields.description: Consensus-serialized TrieMerkleProof.

types.name: NodeRpcSourceOptions
types.summary: Options for reading proofs from a Stacks node.

fields.name: nodeUrl
fields.description: Stacks node RPC origin, e.g. `http://localhost:20443`.

fields.name: getBlock
fields.description: Raw Nakamoto block bytes (header first), by block id or height.

fields.name: getEpoch2Header
fields.description:
Epoch 2.x block header by index block hash: blocks below the checkpoint
from before Nakamoto. Without it only Nakamoto blocks verify.

fields.name: getMarfProof
fields.description:
MARF inclusion proof for a 32-byte path at `tipId`; null when the key is
absent. Blocks below the checkpoint also ask for
`__MARF_BLOCK_HEIGHT_TO_HASH::<height>`, whose value is no stored string:
only `proof` is read for it.

fields.name: getWitness
fields.description: State witness (wire v3) for a block.

fields.name: getBitcoinHeaders
fields.description: Raw 80-byte Bitcoin headers (hex or bytes) from height `from`.

fields.name: getStateWrites
fields.description:
Every MARF write of the block, in ordinal order; null (or empty) when
the source has none for it. Names the block's diff.

fields.name: getVmEvents
fields.description: Indexed vm_events write rows of the block, checked against its proven diff.

types.name: SecondlayerSourceOptions
types.summary: Options for reading proofs from the Secondlayer API.

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.description: API origin. Defaults to [`DEFAULT_API_URL`](/docs/verify-reference#c-DEFAULT_API_URL).

fields.name: apiKey
fields.description:
Optional. Proofs are keyless; a key raises the rate limit. Required for
`rows: true` (metered Index reads). Sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

types.name: StateWrite
types.summary: One storage-layer MARF write (`state_writes` row), in block write order.

fields.name: tx_index
fields.description: Null for block-level writes outside any transaction.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Full MARF key, e.g. `vm::<contract>::0::<map>::<key hex>`.

fields.name: value_hex
fields.description: Hex of the stored value string's UTF-8 bytes.

types.name: VmEventRow
types.summary: A `vm_events` write row, as the Index API serves it.

fields.name: event_index
fields.description: The row's ordinal within the block.
